faq.a: None — there aren't any. You pay for the people who use HBCField plus whatever you switch on. That is the whole model, and it exists because the old one made people upgrade every seat to reach one feature.

One place or operation you run separately: a branch, a building, a contract, a client, a crew. Most businesses start with one and add more only when the work is genuinely separate. Adding a site is free — you pay only for what that site switches on.

faq.q: Do I pay for a module in every site?
faq.a: Only in the sites that use it. Switch GPS on for the mobile crew and leave it off at the workshop, and you pay for one. Add-ons work the other way round: they are bought once for the whole company, however many sites you have.

faq.q: What happens if I add someone halfway through the month?
faq.a: You are charged for the part of the month they were there, not the whole month. The same applies to anything you switch on or off.

faq.q: Is there a minimum, or a contract?
faq.a: One person, one site, one month. No minimum team size, no setup fee and no annual commitment — billing is monthly, and you can stop at any time.

faq.q: What happens when my trial ends?
faq.a: Nothing is charged automatically. If you have not entered a card the account simply locks until you do, and your data waits for you.
Yes — for organisations on a negotiated agreement we bill outside the app and nothing is charged to a card. Write to us and we will set it up.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.subtitle: HBCField — Field Service Management Platform
privacy.intro: HBC Group GmbH ("we", "our", "us") operates the HBCField mobile application and web platform. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, and protect your information when you use our services.

s1.title: 1. Information We Collect
s1.accountRole: Role and permissions within your organization
s1.gpsIntro: — collected only during active work activities:
s1.gps1: When driving to a job site (EN_ROUTE status) — your route is recorded continuously in the background, even when the app is closed or not in use
s1.gps2: When clocking in or out (single GPS fix for attendance verification)
s1.gps3: When marking arrival at a job site (geofence verification)
s1.cachedText: — used for presence indicators on the dispatcher's live map. This uses the device's last known position without activating the GPS radio.
s1.neverPost: when you are browsing tasks, viewing your profile, or outside active work — that is, when you are not driving to a job and not clocked in.
s1.work2: Clock in/out times and break durations
s1.work3: Service reports including text descriptions, photos you take with your device camera or select from your photo library, and digital signatures
s1.device1: Device type and operating system (for push notifications)

s2.title: 2. How We Use Your Information
s2.item1: To provide field service management functionality
s2.item2: To enable real-time location tracking for dispatchers during active work
s2.item3: To verify attendance via geofencing at company locations
s2.item4: To verify employee presence at job sites before starting work
s2.item5: To send push notifications for task assignments, status updates, and comments
s2.item6: To generate service reports and maintain work history
s2.item7: To display route tracking on completed tasks
s2.item8: To improve app performance and fix bugs

s3.title: 3. Legal Basis for Processing (GDPR)
s3.intro: Where the General Data Protection Regulation applies, we process your personal data on the following legal bases:
s3.contractText: — to provide the HBCField service to your organization and to you as an authorized user, including task assignment, location-based dispatching, attendance verification, and service reporting.
s3.legitText: — to secure our platform, prevent fraud and abuse, maintain service reliability, and improve the product. Our legitimate interests are balanced against your rights and freedoms.
s3.consentText: — for optional features such as push notifications, which you can disable at any time in your device settings.
s3.legalText: — where we are required to retain records for tax, labor, or other statutory obligations applicable to your organization.

s4.title: 4. Data Sharing
s4.noSellPost: sell your personal data to third parties.
s4.internal: Your data is shared only within your organization — admin and dispatcher users can see employee locations and work activity.
s4.thirdPartyIntro: We use the following third-party services:

s5.title: 5. Data Storage & Security
s5.euPre: All data is stored on servers located in the
s5.item2: Data is encrypted in transit using TLS/HTTPS
s5.item3: Passwords are hashed using bcrypt with cost factor 12
s5.item4: Authentication tokens are SHA-256 hashed before storage
s5.item5: Refresh tokens use rotation with grace periods for concurrent requests
s5.item6: Access is restricted by role-based permissions (RBAC)
s5.item7: Rate limiting protects against brute-force attacks (10 req/sec, 200 req/min)
s5.item8: Account lockout after 5 failed login attempts (15-minute cooldown)
s5.item9: File uploads are stored in S3-compatible object storage with presigned URLs

s6.title: 6. Data Retention
s6.item1: Account data is retained while your account is active
s6.item2: Location history (route tracking) is retained for 90 days
s6.item3: Service reports are retained according to your organization's record-keeping requirements
s6.item4: Refresh tokens are automatically cleaned up after expiration
s6.item5: You can request complete data deletion at any time

s7.title: 7. Your Rights (GDPR)
s7.intro: If you are located in the European Union or European Economic Area, you have the following rights under the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR):
s7.accessText: — Request a copy of your personal data
s7.erasureText: — Request deletion of your personal data ("right to be forgotten"). You can delete your account and all associated data yourself, at any time, directly in the app: Profile → Account → Delete Account.
s7.portabilityText: — Receive your data in a structured, machine-readable format
s7.objectText: — Object to processing of your personal data
s7.withdrawText: — Withdraw your consent at any time
s7.complaintText: — You have the right to lodge a complaint with your local data protection authority if you believe your rights have been infringed.
s7.contactPre: To exercise any of these rights, contact us at

s8.title: 8. Location Tracking Disclosure
s8.intro: HBCField uses location data as a core part of its field service management functionality. Here is exactly when and how location is used:
s8.drivingText: Continuous background tracking — even when the app is closed or not in use — approximately every 15 seconds, to record your route to the job site
s8.clockText: Single high-accuracy fix for attendance verification
s8.arrivingText: Single high-accuracy fix for geofence verification (20m radius)
s8.inactive1: Browsing tasks, viewing profile, changing settings
s8.inactive2: The app is in the background or closed and you are not driving to a job (route tracking) or clocked in
s8.inactive3: Presence indicator uses cached OS location only (no GPS activation)
s8.safeguard1: Only dispatchers and admins within your organization can see your location
s8.safeguard2: Location data is never shared outside your organization
s8.safeguard3: Route data from completed tasks is retained for 90 days
s8.safeguard4: You can see your own location data in the app

s9.title: 9. Push Notifications
s9.disable: You can disable push notifications in your device settings at any time.

s10.title: 10. Children's Privacy
s10.body: HBCField is a workplace application designed for professional use. It is not intended for use by individuals under 18 years of age. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children.

s11.title: 11. International Data Transfers
s11.body: Your data is processed and stored within the European Union. Push notification delivery may involve routing through Google (FCM) or Apple (APNs) infrastructure, which may process data outside the EU. These transfers are covered by the EU-US Data Privacy Framework and Standard Contractual Clauses.

s12.title: 12. Changes to This Policy
s12.body: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time to reflect changes in our practices or legal requirements. We will notify users of material changes via email or in-app notification. The "Last updated" date at the top of this page indicates when this policy was last revised.

privacy.footerRights: HBC Group GmbH. All rights reserved.
